errors.message:
Streamable HTTP error: Error POSTing to endpoint: Firmament: this client is not signed in, so the call did not run. Nothing was recorded.

Signing in takes one browser step, once per client:
  MCP client (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code): reconnect the Firmament connector. In Claude Code, run /mcp from a terminal session.
  Command line: run `firmament login`.

If you are an agent reading this: tell the person you are working with that Firmament needs them to sign in, and give them the line above. Do not retry silently. Every retry fails the same way until a human signs in.
